description: Curated general-purpose corrections for the 'Object with Logo in Simple Scene Generator' capability. Independently maintained from corrections.v1.json, which also contains infra-specific rules (balloon arch, LED posters, Chauvet lights, bar stools, step-and-repeat) that do not apply here. Iteration lever: bench failure -> activate/adjust a note -> re-bench.

corrections.failureMode: Scene pass re-touches or corrupts the EV branding done in stage 1
corrections.note: The EV branding in IMAGE A is FINAL. Do not repaint, move, add or remove any logo on the vehicle. Reproduce the vehicle pixel-faithful including all its current branding.

corrections.failureMode: Staff generated inside the EV or behind a service counter
corrections.note: NON-NEGOTIABLE: the SNACKET EV is not a food truck and has no interior service capacity. The EV Operator and Brand Ambassador must ALWAYS be standing on the ground, OUTSIDE the vehicle — never inside it, never behind a service counter, never framed within the service window opening. The service window opening shows only the vehicle's interior equipment — no person inside it, ever, regardless of venue or theme.

corrections.failureMode: Staff shown completely isolated with zero other people visible anywhere in the frame
corrections.note: At least one other person (bystander, passerby) should be visible somewhere in the scene near the EV — staff should not appear completely alone with nobody else anywhere in the frame. Pose, gesture, and the specific form of interaction are NOT constrained — any natural, freely-chosen pose is acceptable.

corrections.failureMode: Model defaults toward familiar 'brand activation event' visual tropes and adds staged infrastructure despite it not being requested
corrections.note: CRITICAL: this is NOT a staged brand-activation event. Do NOT render a balloon arch, LED floor posters, a backdrop or step-and-repeat panel, bar tables or stools, colored floor-mounted lighting fixtures, or a professional photographer — none of these exist in this scene under any circumstances, regardless of venue or theme.

corrections.failureMode: Output contains text overlays, borders or watermarks
corrections.note: No text overlays, no borders, no watermarks, no captions anywhere in the output image.
